en: Color postcard showing a sunlit Italian square with a large baroque fountain in the foreground and a Romanesque cathedral with a central rose window and octagonal drum in the background. To the right is a tall tower with an onion-shaped green dome. Handwritten Italian text appears along the right margin, and printed captions identify the place and publisher.
